AI turns of the vibe-coding sessions

Source: R/data-human_ai.R
ai_simplified.Rd

ai_simplified is the AI part of human_ai: its AI rows, as one data frame for one actor type. Together with human_simplified it is the input for the named-list form of build_htna(), in which each actor type comes in its own data frame.

Usage

ai_simplified

Format

A data frame with 8,551 rows and 10 columns: the columns of human_ai without phase; actor_type is always "AI".

Source

Derived from the ai_long data of the 'Nestimate' package (see human_ai).

See also

human_ai, human_simplified, human_ai_codebook

Examples

data(human_simplified, ai_simplified)
net <- build_htna(list(Human = human_simplified, AI = ai_simplified))
#> Registered S3 methods overwritten by 'Nestimate':
#>   method            from       
#>   plot.net_mlvar    idiographic
#>   print.net_mlvar   idiographic
#>   summary.net_mlvar idiographic
#> Metadata aggregated per session: ties resolved by first occurrence in 'session_date' (1 sessions), 'cluster' (42 sessions), 'actor_type' (24 sessions)
summary(net)
